caseName: Commercial Stevedoring Co. v. A/S J. Ludwig Mowinckels Rederi
caseNameFull: Commercial Stevedoring Co., Inc. v. A/S J. Ludwig Mowinckels Rederi
attorneys: Horace M. Gray was on the stipulation for petitioner. With him on the petition was Leo F. Hanan. James M. Estabrook was on the stipulation for respondent. With him on a brief in opposition to the petition was Francis X. Byrn.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
